message: Hi, my little one Cora is 5 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?
Hi! Yes, we do! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for ages 4-7, so Cora would be a perfect fit. It's a great program for that age group. Are you interested in booking a free trial class for her?
Yes, I’d love to book a free trial class for her! What time slots do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.meadow@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! Now I just need Cora's full name and date of birth to get her trial scheduled.
Cora's full name is Cora Meadow, and her birthday is April 2, 2021.

Perfect! I have Cora all set. Here are the available times for her free trial class:

Wednesday, July 8 at 4:45 PM
Monday, July 13 at 4:45 PM

Which works better for you?
Let's go with Wednesday, July 8 at 4:45 PM. Thank you!

Awesome! Cora is all booked for Wednesday, July 8 at 4:45 PM. We'll send the confirmation and details to tester.meadow@gmail.com. We're excited to see her on the mat! Let me know if you have any questions before then.
